svg.aria-label: Inner-wall shape consistent with the measured scan (one smooth solution)
svg.text: Inner-wall shape consistent with the measured scan (one smooth solution)
The conical wall unrolled: azimuth φ across, position along the axis z upwards (0 = entrance, 100 mm = PMT end).
A Local unevenness: δ(φ, z) minus its azimuthal mean at the same z
Red = wall bulges into the cavity (bump), blue = wall recedes (dent); band step 0.008 mm, dashed line = zero
C Total deviation from the CAD cone δ(φ, z) = azimuthal mean + local unevenness
Same colour convention; band step 0.1 mm. Dominated by the axisymmetric part (measured entrance radius is 0.28 mm below CAD)
x, y are the scan-stage axes,
z runs along the axis to the PMT.
Vector figure, zoom freely. This is one smooth wall that reproduces the 100×100-point scan; the scan constrains only part of the wall shape, so the solution is not unique.
